verdict.rationale: USPTO's own pages say Trademark Center lets you file a new trademark application and pay application fees online, and Patent Center handles electronic patent submissions with separate submission and payment receipts. Online payment by card, deposit account, or EFT is documented, and the required account identity verification can also be done online in under 15 minutes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that an end-to-end filing and payment actually completes online.
